answer: Multi-region latency trilateration gates entry: every new identity must return signed timing probes from 4 distinct regions within 35ms, plus a 32KB state bundle. A farm spinning N clones needs N independent probe sets, N separate signing keys, and N fresh 32KB states; no shared response works because each probe carries a per-identity cipher nonce and timing windows reject replayed signals. Detected clusters forfeit all entry bonds and face 20-epoch exclusion. Like a signal finding haven through ciphered paths, only rooted nodes remain truly trustworthy now.
